people.name: Shuji Yamagiri
people.role: Director, Stage Manager, Keynote Speaker, and Musician
people.biography: Representative of DIO Entertainment. Shuji has led productions including MAIN MATSURI and the ABAC international conference gala dinner show, and has stage-managed events at JZ Brat, Sakura Hall, Densho Hall, and other major venues. As a musician with KAO=S, he performed at SXSW and composed the theme song for Germany's MAIN MATSURI. At 50, he completed a solo tour across all 47 prefectures of Japan.
appealPoints: Transforms an event's purpose into a compelling audience experience
Leads complex productions from international events to live concerts
Connects speaking, music, and stagecraft into one coherent story

people.name: Kaori Kawabuchi
people.role: Sword-fight and sword-dance performer / LADY SAMURAI
people.biography: A member of IDEAL, a samurai sword-fight and sword-dance performance team. As LADY SAMURAI, Kaori brings the beauty of Japanese physical expression and action to audiences in Japan and around the world. Through stage works and international performances, she presents Japanese culture with both strength and precision.
appealPoints: High-impact sword fighting and sword dance with precise technique
Physical storytelling and stage presence that cross language barriers
Performance and program proposals tailored to each production's world

people.name: KAO=S / LADY SAMURAI’S CHAOS
people.role: Guitar, sword dance, and vocal rock unit / Japanese live project
people.biography: KAO=S, led by Shuji Yamagiri and Kaori Kawabuchi, appeared on a CNN program with its signature song ‘Sakura no Oni’. The unit has performed in Japan and overseas, with LADY SAMURAI’S CHAOS expanding the format through samurai and traditional instrumentalists.
appealPoints: A distinctive live language combining music and sword dance
International reach through CNN coverage, SXSW, and overseas shows
Flexible ensemble size and program design

people.name: IDEAL
people.role: Sword fighting, sword dance, fan dance, and stage combat team
people.biography: A mixed-gender performance team delivering bold, elegant stages through sword fighting, sword dance, fan dance, and choreographed combat. IDEAL adapts its ensemble size and program to festivals, ceremonies, corporate events, and international cultural exchange.
appealPoints: Action performance balancing impact and precision
Flexible cast size, program length, and staging
Visual storytelling that crosses language barriers
